checks.name: the bridge is version 9 or later, with the card import
the card lists its two recordings, the split one as one of two parts, and nothing hidden, Windows' own, a side file or through the junction
the page is told no place: not the card's, the folders' or the Windows user name
both recordings are copied and verified: each named once it read back the same, no part file left
the joined recording is the camera's stream byte for byte (SHA-256), and the other file the card's
the joined recording is read as one MPEG-TS stream
the page gets a token for each copy, and reads it where it is
a cancel mid-copy leaves no part file and no copy
a part pulled out mid-copy fails that recording and leaves no part file and no copy
nothing is copied onto the card itself
a key not of this listing, an empty choice and another listing are refused

notes: The card took 7 s to make: a recording of 2.07 GB split in two parts; the junction out of the card was made.
Copied and verified 2.069 GB in 5.4 s: 2.6 s a GB on this laptop's disk (read, write, read back).

timing.includes: reading the card, writing the copy, reading the copy back
